name: hopper
description: Vendor-neutral background dispatch for AI agents. Thin plugin layer over the llm-hopper file-based protocol: dispatches task-typed work to vendor CLI subprocesses (codex, kimi, opencode, copilot, agy, grok, mimo, claude). State lives in plain markdown and JSONL under .hopper/.
author: litianyi-007
skillInstructions: Use the hopper skills when the user wants to dispatch work to external vendor CLIs (codex, kimi, opencode, copilot, agy, grok, mimo, claude) as background jobs through the llm-hopper file-based protocol. hopper is the entry skill; hopper-dispatch submits tasks; hopper-status and hopper-progress inspect running jobs; hopper-result collects outputs; hopper-setup initializes .hopper/ state; hopper-smoke verifies vendor CLIs; hopper-models and hopper-vendors list catalogs and routing; hopper-probe checks connectivity. All state lives in plain markdown and JSONL under .hopper/. Follow each skill's SKILL.md exactly; do not invent vendor availability when a probe or smoke check fails.

interface.shortDescription: Vendor-neutral background dispatch for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Hopper is a thin plugin layer over the llm-hopper file protocol. It dispatches task-typed work to vendor CLI subprocesses (codex, kimi, opencode, copilot, agy, grok, mimo, claude) as background jobs, with state kept in plain markdown and JSONL files under .hopper/ — no hidden database, no automatic vendor retry or fallback. Includes skills for setup, dispatch, status, progress, results, smoke tests, model/vendor catalogs, and connectivity probes, plus a CLI (hopper-dispatch, hopper-runner, hopper-dashboard).
